# introduction
Read the guidelines at .github/copilot-instructions. You have the role of reviewer, you will write plans for analyzer and then start an analyzer subagent to carry out that those plans. It is up to you how to schedule and send off the tasks to analyzer subagent(s), but keep the work of each subagent isolated. Be careful of recompiling executables which might be in use by another program. If there is a chance a file is being edited or executable ran or will soon-to-be ran by anther subagent, then wait until that subagent's task has concluded. For analysis production use 20-30 threads, for skimming use 5 threads for mc and 10 threads for data.

# residual correction test continued
Make a new file in the track residual correction directory for pp systematics, called run-pp-systematics.sh, modeled after run-pPb-sysstematics.sh, that includes all pp systematic variation corrections that need to be ran. This file, and the pPb file, should be reran whenever we recalcualate the track residuals.

In the last task 20260411-5.md we calculated track-residuals in this directory for the test case where we set the highest track pT bin to 15 GeV. There are a few bugs that need to be fixed however. Make a new runner script designed specifically to test out the nominal and isMuTagged=false variation study residuals. The last residuals do not close in the sense that when we look at the closure plots made in 20251211_ResidualCorrection/workflow/plots, eta and phi close but not the track pT. First ensure that when we calcualte the new residuals that we use the max 15 GeV bin for both the reco and gen runs, and for the correction histograms as well. Change the correction factor histogram plotting to automatically plot the dynamix range for the track pT histogram. Currently we see it go out to 200 still even when we change the max to 15. Do the same for the closure -pt plots. Rerun the track residual calculation for the nominal case and muon-track variation. If the nonclosure still exists in the pT dimension, or it is still filling to 200 GeV then continue debugging, we should see near perfect closure with the factors we calculate.


# conclusion
Make the minimum number of edits necessary to implement functionality. Do not add superflous error statement catches or checks. 

Have the subanalyzer handoff a summary to you and you should review that summary for flaws. Update copilot instructions on the new norms detailed here and learned by you or the subanalyzer throught these tasks.
